meta.title: {{home}} v {{away}} | Puntr
meta.description: Post a pick on {{home}} v {{away}} ({{competition}}) before kick-off. Locked at kick-off, graded automatically and kept forever.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that match
notFound.body: It may have been removed or the link may be wrong.

countdown.closed: Picks are closed for this match.

form.title: Post your pick
form.lineHint: Added to {{home}}'s score. -6.5 means {{home}} give 6.5 points; +6.5 means they get 6.5.
form.confidenceHint: 1 is a hunch, 5 is a strong view.
form.reasoningHint: Up to 280 characters. It is public.
form.permanent: Once locked, a pick cannot be edited or deleted. It stays on your public record.
form.signIn: Create a free account to post a pick on this match.
form.needProfile: Finish setting up your profile to post picks.
form.success: Pick locked. It is on your public record.

problem.line: Enter a handicap line such as -6.5.
problem.odds: Enter odds between 1.01 and 50, with at most two decimals.

form.needEmail: Confirm your email to post a pick.
form.needEmailWhy: Picks go on the public feed and the leaderboard, so we ask for a confirmed email first. It takes a minute.

error.kickoff_passed: This match has kicked off - picks are locked.
error.fixture_not_open: This match is no longer open for picks.
error.duplicate: You already have a {{market}} pick on this game.
error.daily_limit: You've reached today's limit of 30 picks. Try again tomorrow.
error.posting_paused: Posting is paused on your account. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
error.banned: Your account can't post picks. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
error.age_not_attested: We need your 18+ confirmation before you can post.
error.no_profile: Finish setting up your profile to post picks.
error.not_authenticated: Please sign in again to post a pick.
error.invalid_market_for_sport: That market isn't available for this sport.
error.invalid_selection: That pick isn't valid for this market.
error.invalid_odds: Enter odds between 1.01 and 50, with at most two decimals.
error.generic: We couldn't lock your pick. Please try again.
error.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email to post a pick. You can do it on your account's security page.

picks.title: Picks on this match
picks.empty: No picks yet. Be the first to post one.
picks.loadError: We couldn't load the picks. Please refresh the page.

crowd.title: Crowd split (Match result)
crowd.note: Based on {{count}} Match result picks. Sample size matters: a small sample says little.

report.title: Report this pick
report.body: Tell us what is wrong. A person will look at it.
report.signIn: Sign in to report a pick.
report.error: We couldn't send your report. Please try again.

share.title: Share your pick
share.body: Your pick is locked. Share it with friends.
